item.title: Warming back up this week
item.description: The warmest day of the week will be Wednesday when highs will be very close to 90 degrees. We may see a few record highs!

item.title: City of Lincoln opens application process for water quality landscape funding
item.description: Lincolnites can now apply for the Rainscaping Lincoln-Sustainable Landscapes Cost Share Program until April 24 or until funding runs out.

item.title: Online tool connects farmers with available land to cattle ranchers in need of grazing area after wildfires
item.description: "We're seeing tremendous amounts of generosity; tragedies like wildfire just really bring out the best in the AG community,"

item.title: Midday Interview: Southview Baptist Church Easter Performance
item.description: It's called “This Day of Resurrection” and the first show will be March 25. The director joined Channel 8 News at midday to discuss.

item.title: Warm Tuesday Before Hot Wednesday
item.description: A warm &amp; breezy day across the state. Wednesday brings more record heat and fire weather. Active weather next week.

item.title: 'It's an experience': Lincoln coffee shops work hard to combat rise in drive-thru options
item.description: Despite the ease of going to a drive-thru, Mark Shriner wants to remind people that it can be worth your time to invest locally.

item.title: City of Waverly votes to erect 195-foot cell tower near park despite residents' opposition
item.description: "The Park and Recreation Department would make $1,000 a month from this, with a $5,000 stipend for each new carrier that joins the tower."

item.title: Windy & Cool Tuesday- Rain Likely Wednesday
item.description: Today, expect lots of wind and cooler temperatures. Showers & T-storms will begin Wednesday afternoon through Thursday morning!

item.title: Project O Street pre-construction traffic changes set to start Sunday
item.description: On Sunday, westbound lanes on O Street between 13th and 16th streets will close for tree removal and pre-construction work.

item.title: Rain chances increasing
item.description: Different waves of precipitation are headed our way. It won't be raining all the time, but it would be worth it to have an umbrella handy!

item.title: Lincoln neighborhood pleading for overdue changes to intersection with increased traffic
item.description: With the expansion of businesses near the intersection, it's not making it any easier for people trying to cross the street, and some drivers.

item.title: 'It felt surreal': Nebraska caregiver surprised with new car
item.description: The Nebraska Health Care Foundation and Chariots4Hope partnered together for the program called "Cars for Caregivers."

item.title: I-80 eastbound closed near Milford due to crash
item.description: The Nebraska Department of Transportation said I-80 eastbound is closed near the Milford exit due to a crash.
